name: session-summary
description: Recap a session as one bullet per request the owner made, each with an honest status.

interface.shortDescription: What you asked for, and where each one stands.
interface.longDescription: Reads the session's own requests and returns one bullet per request, written the way you asked for it, each carrying an honest status: done, partly done, blocked, waiting on you, dropped, or answered.
